summary.name: Hiring Site Reliability Engineers
summary.one_liner: A ;login: (USENIX) article describing how Google hires Site Reliability Engineers, using standardized interviews and committee-based hiring decisions.
use_cases: Designing an interview process for SRE or DevOps candidates
Deciding how to make consistent hiring decisions across a team
Understanding the skill mix needed for SRE roles
Growing an SRE or DevOps team with high hiring standards
summary.what_it_does: The article explains that operating distributed systems at scale needs a mix of problem solving, programming, system design, networking, and OS internals skills. It describes how Google hires SREs with a blend of software and systems skills. It covers two practices: standardizing the format of interviews and making hiring decisions by committee. The author suggests these practices can help SRE or DevOps teams hire consistently. The page text is a short abstract and does not include the full article details.
